verdict.rationale: No documented export feature or open export format appears in the evidence. The only possible exit paths are workarounds: programmatic access to conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts through the API and the official MCP server, contacts syncing with Office 365/Google, and attachments downloading locally. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export tool, named open export formats (e.g. mbox/EML/CSV/vCard), coverage of chats, comments and team data, offboarding or account-deletion guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
